title: The Emperor Sword
summary: Inside Hong Prison, Wang Lin's clone kills the condemned prisoners for five days but gains only useless death qi, not killing intent. The prison head Xu Huichuan offers him a real path of slaughter if he will later kill a Demon General for him, and leads him to the Slaughter Blood Pool, where the Demon Emperor nurtures the Emperor Sword on the blood mist of prisoners forced to fight each other forever. Watching how the sword turns death into life, Wang Lin understands that the Slaughter Immortal Art is really a Dao of life and death in cycle, and he breaks out with killing intent and his Life Seal, even holding off the Emperor Sword's attack. The enraged sword flies through Sky Demon City, alarming Mo Fei and the Da Lou Sword Sect disciples Kang Ni and Wei Yang at the Sword Pavilion. Xu Huichuan hurries Wang Lin out and away, and in hiding Wang Lin finishes refining 3,792 strands of killing intent.

changes: Main source: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub (ep117.id.srt) and its caption cards; the YouTube English track for this episode is machine-made and garbled, used only for cross-checks.
flags: Xu Huichuan's target is called Demon General 'Shi Yan' (207s); probably a slip for Shi Xiao.
'Kang Ni' is the card spelling (823s); the glossary has no Kang Ni, but lists Hai Zhu (亥猪) as debuting in EP117, possibly the same person.
Who leads Wang Lin to a hiding place (907s, 'Ikuti aku') and who says 'it really is him' (915s) is not clear.
At the Slaughter Blood Pool someone trapped begs 'save me' (777s); unnamed.
